draft.subject: A quick hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

Following up on our getting started call last week — I haven't wanted to crowd your inbox, but I'd still like to make the first steps easy.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so getting one project up is usually the thing that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to walk through your first project together, or just answer questions by email.

Best,
Nadia
